verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS hiring platform like Lever, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of any telemetry controls, usage-tracking opt-out, or data-sharing preferences. The cross-customer benchmarking claim ('insights from over 26,000 talent teams') describes aggregate data use, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
